worksheet.title: Founder Rules Sheet
worksheet.description: Set the operating rules that will guide your time, budget, and business decisions during the next stage of building.

fields.label: Hours per week
fields.helpText: The honest number: what you can sustain even during a busy week. For most people starting out, this is between 5 and 15 hours.

fields.label: Fixed work blocks
fields.helpText: Specific days and times you will protect for this work. 'Tuesday and Thursday evenings 7–9' is a rule. 'Whenever I get a chance' is a wish.

fields.label: Weekly review slot
fields.helpText: A fixed 20–30 minute slot each week to review what happened, check the numbers, and decide what to focus on next.

fields.label: Monthly spending cap
fields.helpText: The total amount you can spend each month without it causing stress. You can increase this later when revenue starts coming in.

fields.label: Maximum tooling spend
fields.helpText: How much of your monthly cap goes to recurring tools (store platform, email software, design tools). Keep this as low as possible early on.

fields.label: Testing vs tooling split
fields.helpText: How you divide your budget between testing (ad spend, samples, listing fees) and tools. Example: '80% testing / 20% tools'.

fields.label: Minimum experiment duration
fields.helpText: How long you will run a test before judging the result. Example: '3 weeks'. Prevents pulling the plug too early.

fields.label: Kill criteria: I will stop if…
fields.helpText: What results would tell you to stop and try a different idea. Make this specific enough that you will know it when you see it.

fields.label: Continue criteria: I will keep going if…
fields.helpText: What early signs are encouraging enough to justify giving an idea more time, even if results are not dramatic yet.

fields.label: Escalation criteria: I will invest more when…
fields.helpText: What results are strong enough to justify increasing your time, budget, or effort.

fields.label: Data-over-ego commitment
fields.helpText: Write your personal version of this commitment: your attachment to an idea is not a reason to keep going: evidence is. Optional but recommended.

fields.label: Red-line rules (non-negotiables)
fields.helpText: The boundaries you will not cross regardless of how things are going. List 2–4 rules. Example: 'I will not skip my weekly review.'
